approval_gate: Before predictions are read: verify reference seal, exact human-approved CSV hashes, explicit approval metadata, both independent source-submission receipts, selected recording hashes and selected identities. Unapproved/missing/modified references are rejected.
primary_unit: One sampled run/object with determinate applicable approved reference. Never include non-applicable units as TNs. Unknown reference labels remain excluded and counted explicitly.
coverage: Shared saved-frame projection only, not continuous/video synchronization equivalence. All approved actual reviewed intervals must be covered by recorded measurement intervals. A determinate negative also requires frozen negative proof coverage over those intervals. A positive must localize an R1 event within reviewed intervals. Frozen insufficient_information/not_applicable outputs never become negatives from partial proof or absent events.
events: Retain all final_label_json and compound subevents. Only explicit human-approved evaluation_mapping phases with compatible_type, phase and scope enter matching. Unmapped/uncertain components stay unscorable; no automatic interpretation of free text. Known no-event fragments provide adjudicable negative windows; unannotated frames never become TNs or event FPs.
matching: Reuse immutable maximum-cardinality one-to-one matching: inclusive saved-frame overlap AND onset-bracket compatibility; ties by total IoU, minimum onset distance and stable IDs. Partition run/object/version/type/phase/scope. Tolerance sensitivity 0 and 1 saved frame, nominal 0.05 s. Unknown/censored endpoints do not become exact errors.
metrics: Applicability confusion over all 20; binary TP/FP/FN/TN conditional on compatible determinate applicable cases; decision coverage and abstentions; scope alarms on non-applicable cases separately. Precision undefined with zero positive predictions. Recall and positive F1 not estimable with zero positive reference units. End-to-end recall counts abstentions as missed positives when positive eligible references exist.
uncertainty: Primary eligibility per adjudicated claim, not blanket deletion because an unrelated event is uncertain. Also report sensitivity excluding any selected unit linked to partially unresolved requests/unresolved components.
limitations: Four-case development answers are never reviewer inputs or new reference labels. No current accuracy computation; new labels must come from the two independent humans and approved adjudication. Sampling prior exposure remains disclosed.
